title: Market-led quarterly cadence: Hosted API model substitution & sprint orchestration
creator: Leah Ortega
description: Define and operationalize a quarterly cadence that pairs hosted API endpoint deprecation with model substitution lanes and experiment rollouts. Deliverables: a dependency-aware sprint orchestration template, substitution decision criteria (quality/cost/latency thresholds), canary scheduling guidance, and a set of experiment lanes for staggered rollouts across customer cohorts.
acceptance_criteria: A dependency matrix mapping endpoint assets to model variants and infra constraints is available and reviewed by ENG and SRE
Substitution decision criteria documented with numeric thresholds for latency, cost delta, and regression tolerance
A sprint orchestration template that schedules canaries, A/B experiment lanes, and fallback windows
Two pilot endpoint substitutions executed during the quarter with post-mortem and metrics dashboard links
